cast_dialogue.linea: 'Out' is the particle of discovery, heroes: finding out, working out, figuring out. The truth always comes out!
Someone ate Abuela Carmen's chocolates! I'm going to find out who it was.
I can't work out how the box was opened. It was on the highest shelf!
Look out! The cat is running out of the kitchen with something brown in its mouth.
Don't carry out an investigation, mis héroes. It turned out I ate them myself... and I've run out of excuses!

banco_oraciones.oracion: I'm going to find out the truth.
They sorted out the mess quickly.
It turned out that the cat was innocent.
She handed out the exam papers.
I can't work out this puzzle.
We didn't run out of milk.
He didn't point out the mistake.
Did you find out who ate the chocolates?
How did it turn out in the end?
Can you help out this weekend?
Did you figure it out? Yes, I did.
Did they run out of time? No, they didn't.
Did the plan work out? Yes, it did.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Phrasal verbs with 'out' often express discovery (find out, figure out, work out), distribution (give out, hand out), completion (sort out, carry out) or results (turn out). 'Run out of' means to have none left.

filas: find out, work out, figure out
sort out, carry out, fill out
It turned out fine. / We've run out of milk.

ejercicios.respuesta: I found out the printer was broken. I couldn't work out why. In the end, my brother sorted it out.

guion: Ben: Abuela Carmen! Someone has eaten your chocolates!
Abuela Carmen: What?! The box was full this morning.
Ben: Don't worry. I'll find out who it was. Kenji, help me carry out an investigation.
Kenji: Look — paw prints! It must be the cat.
Sofía: Wait... the cat was outside all day. I can't work it out.
Abuela Carmen: Mis héroes... it turned out I ate them myself last night!
Ben: Mystery solved. But next time, write it down!

reading.texto: Ben decided to find out who had eaten Abuela Carmen's chocolates. He looked out of the window and saw the cat running out of the kitchen. 'I can't work out how it opened the box,' he laughed. Later the friends helped him sort out the mess, put out the candles, and carried out a full investigation. It turned out the cat was innocent — the thief was Kenji!

preguntas.afirmacion: Ben saw the cat running out of the kitchen.
The friends carried out an investigation.
